content: These references include detailed citations of research articles, their authors, publication years, journal names, and digital object identifiers (DOIs). The studies cover a wide range of interventions, treatments, and outcomes in areas such as dementia care, caregiver support, pharmacological and non-pharmacological therapies, mental health interventions, and addiction recovery strategies. The references also include guidelines and reports from organizations like the World Health Organization (WHO) and other authoritative sources.
